clue.text: Where not to walk, avoiding the extremes

clue.text: A National Trust verge found in Northern Ireland

clue.text: Dine on wet lentil purée - good but often not satisfying

clue.text: Boundary is not settled when on it

clue.text: Principal puts bullets into FBI agent

clue.text: Robin's embarrassed to reach Bristol

clue.text: Parents keeping her in butter and cheese?

clue.text: Unpaid, having left duet unfinished

taken as written

clue.text: Strain to suggest a brain-teaser

clue.text: Blair made reshuffle, which is fine
